title: Exchange of middle product coordinates
statement: Let $E$ be a measurable space and let $\mu$ be an s-finite measure on $E$. The map $((a,b),(c,d))\mapsto((a,c),(b,d))$ preserves the measure $(\mu\otimes\mu)\otimes(\mu\otimes\mu)$ on $(E\times E)\times(E\times E)$.
replaced: Let $E$ be a measurable space and $\mu$ an s-finite measure on $E$. The map $((a,b),(c,d))\mapsto((a,c),(b,d))$ preserves the measure $(\mu\otimes\mu)\otimes(\mu\otimes\mu)$.
